messages:
deploy-bot: postdeploy mini-synth warmup finished for release v2026.03.21 in eu1. Summary: 5/50 probes showed p95 jitter ~2x baseline, others nominal. tagging eng-release for quick triage

maya: saw the spike around the 00:02 warmup window, looks correlated with quant-profile switch on pool-gpu-eu1-3

tony: can you dump the synth logs from that host? link to logs?

deploy-bot: logs uploaded to s3://redwood-deploys/5400001234/eu1-mini-synth/logs.tar.gz :thumbsup:

liam: grabbing logs now. quick grep shows repeated KV warmup retries and a temp 429 from inference-proxy:```
InferenceProxyClient: request failed: 429 Too Many Requests
  at /srv/runtime/proxy/handler.py:87
  token_prefill: 0.024s -> 0.18s (spike)
```

natalie: odd — only the instances with quant-profile "q4_optim" switched in this rollout have the jitter flagged. others on q8 unchanged.

carla: can we verify autoscaler didn't spin up spot instances with different kernel? cpu info: kernel 5.10.102 vs fleet baseline 5.10.99

liam: confirmed two nodes had newer kernel and the kernel upgrade drops a perf knob used by our kernel-sched patch. that could explain latency tail.

maya: proposal: pause rollout for eu1, pin traffic to previous variant (v2026.03.18) for eu1 only, and rollback quant-profile on the 2 affected hosts to q8. thoughts?

tony: +1 for pin and targeted rollback. no need to rollback global release. Also open a postmortem card for kernel-change detection in canary checks.

natalie: steps to do the pin: deploybot pin-route --route eu1 --to v2026.03.18 --reason "mini-synth jitter". who can run?

carla: I can run the pin and revert quant on the two hosts. will also add a synthetic that targets those hosts directly to validate warmup. ETA 10m.

deploy-bot: ACTION: pin request queued. to confirm run: `deploybot approve 5400001234-pin`

maya: approving now.

tony: carla, once you revert quant, kick off the targeted probe:```
# runs a 30-run mini probe against instance i-0abcd
scripts/minisynth --instance i-0abcd --runs 30 --report s3://redwood-deploys/5400001234/verification.json
```

carla: started revert on i-0abcd and i-0abce. switching quant-profile to q8. rolling patch applied.

sre-bot: rolling change detected: quant-profile revert applied to i-0abcd,i-0abce by carla at 5400001256

liam: minisynth started, first 10 runs show p95 back to baseline. pushing full 30 run results in 6m.

deploy-bot: pin complete, route eu1 -> v2026.03.18. traffic SWAP completed.

maya: great. hold time window: keep eu1 pinned for 2 hours while we monitor. schedule a gradual unpin only after 2 hours of green synths and no kernel drift on fleet.

natalie: opened ticket INFRA-3217 to add kernel-version check to preflight canary. tagging eng-infra.

tony: quick note for release notes: "Hotfix: targeted roll back of quant-profile in eu1 due to mini-synth warmup jitter; no global rollback." keep in changelog under postdeploy notes.

carla: uploading verification artifact -> s3://redwood-deploys/5400001234/verification.json (30 runs, p95 within baseline)

liam: looks good. recommend unpin after 2h if no regressions.

maya: thanks all. followup: add a dedicated mini-synth that runs during warmup and validates kernel/quant combo before flip. filing a follow-up RFC in #eng-releases-docs. :white_check_mark:
